sahihInternational: But the wretched one will avoid it
yusufAli: But it will be avoided by those most unfortunate ones,
urdu: اور (بےخوف) بدبخت پہلو تہی کرے گا

sahihInternational: When the most wretched of them was sent forth.
yusufAli: Behold, the most wicked man among them was deputed (for impiety).
urdu: جب ان میں سے ایک نہایت بدبخت اٹھا

sahihInternational: None will [enter to] burn therein except the most wretched one
yusufAli: None shall reach it but those most unfortunate ones
urdu: اس میں وہی داخل ہو گا جو بڑا بدبخت ہے
